# FW.md: the firmware outlines counted (generated by fw_cycles.py; do not edit)

Costs a cycle (core.md, "The core's cycle costs"): an instruction 1; a taken branch 3 more; a JAL 2 more; a load's result used at once 1 more; a load from a window 1 more. Memory waits apart.

## The Updater: an update word, decoded and placed

The link delivers a byte a cycle (host-link.md; 17.6.5): a raw update word every 8 cycles; an LRU code every bits/8 cycles. The controller takes one a cycle. "Core share" is the firmware's cycles over the link's: above 1, one core cannot keep up.

| update word | firmware, cycles | controller, cycles | the link's cycles for it | core share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| raw: a header word | 15.0 | 1 | 8.00 | 1.88 |
| raw: a value into the page held, the general path | 25.0 | 1 | 8.00 | 3.12 |
| raw: a value, the fast path (a stretch of a run in the page, unrolled by 4) | 5.5 | 1 | 8.00 | 0.69 |
| LRU: a hit at index 0, a value | 41.8 | 1 | 0.75 | 55.75 |
| LRU: a hit at index 8, a value | 131.8 | 1 | 0.75 | 175.75 |
| LRU: a 34-bit miss, a value | 63.9 | 1 | 4.25 | 15.04 |
| LRU: a 66-bit miss, a value | 81.9 | 1 | 8.25 | 9.93 |
| LRU: a header word (a 66-bit miss) | 71.9 | 1 | 8.25 | 8.72 |
| LRU: the fixtures' mix (4469 codes: 80% hits, mean index 0.13; 17.3 bits a code) | 50.6 | 1 | 2.16 | 23.37 |

The LRU mix is lru_stats.py's over v1.37_wip/tests/updater/divs.frames, v1.37_wip/tests/updater/jumps-base.frames, v1.37_wip/tests/updater/kin-big.frames, v1.37_wip/tests/updater/kin-lru.frames, v1.37_wip/tests/updater/kin-raw.frames, updater_wip/pipeline/gold/test/packets/small.frames: small test fixtures, not proof runs.

| page work | firmware, cycles besides the waits | the waits (the same for the controller) | controller's own cycles |
|---|---|---|---|
| a value in another page: the page held flushed in place, the next looked up and held | 39 | flush_write, lookup | about 6 |
| a fault's step at an index level: source read, owned bits cleared (1,024 entries), page taken, written, entry updated | 7459 | load, new_write, new_update | about 5 |
| the same at the data level (no owned bits to clear) | 35 | load, new_write, new_update | about 5 |
